svg.text: GPIO22-25 do not exist on an S3;
USB-C 5 V (2 A) and a 3.7 V LiPo meet at a power-path / OR-ing stage. The e-Paper HAT and both MOSFET modules run from
5 V; the Heltec regulates its own 3.3 V. All grounds common. Do not power the board without the antenna attached.
e-Paper SCK/MOSI/MISO were on GPIO12/11/13 and DC/CS on GPIO17/18 — the first three are the SX1262, the last two the on-board
OLED, so the bus moved to free pins. e-Paper MISO dropped: the panel is write-only. GPIO22/23 were listed as reserve; neither
